text:
maria (AE): Quick sync on Acme POC — primary asks: prompt inventory for customer workflows, baseline prompt engineering + evals, acceptance criteria, and a pricing constraint. Can SEs + security confirm feasibility by end of week?

sam (SE): I can own the prompt inventory. Need: sample transcripts, typical user intents, and expected output shape. Also what latency SLOs do they need? 100ms or 500ms?

lee (Acme PM): Target is interactive chat for agents, so <200ms median end-to-end is preferred. We'll provide ~200 anonymized transcripts from our ticketing system.

priya (Solutions): For acceptance criteria, recommend: 1) intent classification accuracy >= 92% on core intents, 2) concise actionable responses (avg tokens <= 80), 3) no PII leakage in outputs. Also we should define a small eval set (30 golden prompts).

alex (Sales Engineer): Pricing note: for a 2-week Dedicated trial we can include up to 100k tokens/day at trial rates. If they need longer or higher throughput, we'll need a committed capacity quote.

sam (SE): OK. I'll do prompt categorization: intents, slots, examples, and a baseline prompt for each. Suggest we run 1) zero-shot baseline on our hosted instance, 2) few-shot tuned prompts, 3) optional lightweight fine-tune if needed.

maria (AE): Security request — can someone confirm if SSO + audit logs + data-at-rest encryption are included in the trial? Customer flagged SOC2 implications.

security-bot: Note: SSO + audit logs available for Dedicated and Private. Hosted trial includes KMS-managed encryption; full SOC2 artifacts require enterprise contract. Link: https://redwood.example.com/security/faq

priya (Solutions): Eval harness idea: run these 30 golden prompts, compute: accuracy, ROUGE-L for response completeness, and a hallucination check (binary). We'll wire this into a simple notebook + CI. Sample harness snippet: 

```python
# pseudo-eval
prompts = load_prompts('golden.json')
results = client.run_batch(prompts, model='redwood-1-small', max_tokens=120)
metrics = compute_metrics(prompts, results)
print(metrics)
```

sam (SE): Nice. For prompt inventory format I'll produce a CSV with columns: intent, example_user, system_instructions, few_shot_examples, expected_entity_fields, eval_flag.

lee (Acme PM): On pricing — is the 100k tokens/day enough for a 2-week pilot? Our volume estimate is ~40k/day. That should work. Also need NDA + security questionnaire answered before data transfer.

alex (Sales Engineer): We'll get NDA out today. For the security questionnaire, send the doc to security@redwood.ai and tag me — I'll prioritize.

maria (AE): Action items: 1) Sam: prompt inventory CSV + baseline prompts by Thu EOD. 2) Priya: eval harness + 30 golden prompts by Thu. 3) Alex: draft trial quote and get NDA started. 4) Security-bot / security team: confirm SOC2 artifacts cadence and share questionnaire review ETA. 5) Lee: send anonymized transcripts and security questionnaire ASAP.

sam (SE): On it — will include example prompt variants and a simple few-shot template. Quick sample baseline prompt for their agent workflow: 

`System: You are a helpful support agent. Use the ticket text to suggest next action or draft a reply.`

`User: {ticket_text}`

`Assistant:`

maria (AE): Thanks all — please update this thread as items land. :thumbsup:

lee (Acme PM): Received, will upload transcripts today and add questionnaire answers by EOD tomorrow. Thanks! :pray:
